taxonomic_attenuation.interpretation: Most attenuation occurs between the family-adjusted and genus-adjusted stages, not at the family stage. These fractions are descriptive attenuation, not causal mediation.

cross_context_atomic_geometry.interpretation: The eight-component response vectors are approximately orthogonal to moderately opposed across contexts. This is descriptive geometry, not a new heterogeneity test.

component_examples.northern_midlatitude: actinomorphic_symmetry is positive in both evidence scopes in both primary floristic strata
component_examples.tropical_native_nonendemic: plain_colour and autonomous_selfing are positive in both evidence scopes while none of the four structural-complexity contrasts has a 95% interval excluding zero in either scope

claim_ceiling: Effect-size and vector-geometry synthesis only. Attenuation is not causal mediation; vector angle is not a replacement confirmatory H2 test; no pollinator identity, in-situ evolution or effective service is inferred.
